svg.text: Observed smoke emission by ship (ships with 20+ smokes)
One dot per smoke. Black tick = the base value in the game data; dots to the right of it lasted longer. Red = cut short (the smoker died while emitting).
seconds from activation to the last new puff. The label gives n and the median as a multiple of the base. Groups, top to bottom: flank smoke lines, cap sitters, parked cruiser smoke, moving exhaust.
